title: Git Sources
subtitle: Connect a GitHub App, or a Gitea / Forgejo / Codeberg account, to deploy private repositories.
name: Name
noSources: Add a GitHub App or a Gitea / Forgejo / Codeberg token below to deploy from private repos.
howto: Create a GitHub App on github.com, generate a private key, install it on your repos, then paste the App ID, Installation ID and private key here.
privateRepoDesc: Deploy a private repo through a connected GitHub App or Gitea / Forgejo / Codeberg token.
howtoToken: Create a personal access token in your account settings (Applications) with read access to repositories and the user, then paste it here with the instance URL. The token is validated, stored encrypted and never shown again.
baseUrlHint: https://git.example.com — the instance root, https only.
tokenHint: Write-only — it cannot be viewed after saving.
